title: PDF pages blank in Orca captures and in hidden/occluded windows
cause: Orca captures at first paint (mostly a timing artifact); drawing also relied on IntersectionObserver and pdf.js requestAnimationFrame, which pause in hidden windows
fix: Visibility from scroll geometry, rAF-free print-intent fallback, harness --no-raf mode with pixel check (24/24)

title: Formula cells without cached values show '=C2*D2' instead of a result
cause: Files written by scripts (openpyxl) store no cached values; SheetJS CE does not calculate
fix: Safe formula evaluator (no eval) for common operators and functions, with unit tests (fp-office)

title: Body text falls back to a serif font when Office fonts are missing
cause: Documents name Calibri/Cambria/맑은 고딕, which macOS, Linux and phones lack
fix: @font-face local() aliases to metric-compatible or platform fonts (fp-office)

title: Plugin folder exceeded Orca's 50 MiB limit
cause: Orca counts the whole folder: node_modules, Orca child worktrees and evidence screenshots
fix: Shipped plugin moved to plugin/ (manifest, editor, vendor only: about 6 MB)

title: orca plugin test fails: cannot import ./orca-runtime.mjs
cause: Orca's Windows test loader rejects its own runtime when the plugin is on a different drive (D:) than Orca (C:)
fix: verify.mjs runs unit tests from a temporary copy on the system drive

title: txt/csv/tsv/log/html/svg open in Orca's own Source view first
cause: Orca always treats suffixes it opens itself (and text-looking files) as priority 'option'
fix: Documented: switch with the view toggle at the tab's top right; preview editors are registered for these suffixes

title: A .doc that is really DOCX stayed on the spinner in Orca captures; every file rendered twice
cause: Orca delivers the same document more than once; the dedupe compared object identity
fix: main.ts dedupes by file type and bytes; verify.mjs opens, waits, then captures

title: Extra "기타 그림" gallery with a placeholder picture after the last slide
cause: All unplaced blips (thumbnail/master pictures) were shown

title: PPT 97 slide text smaller and tighter than the same slide elsewhere
cause: Font size / master text style defaults
fix: Read sizes from master text styles (fp-legacy)

title: Korean glyphs heavier than Latin, lines nearly touch
DOCX unreadable on phones (page fitted at ~43%, ~5 px text)
cause: Fixed page width scaled down to fit
fix: Reading/reflow mode by default on phones (fp-office)

title: Word table style and cell padding not applied
cause: docx-preview ignores conditional table formatting and default cell margins
fix: CSS fallbacks for header/banding and padding (fp-office)

title: Dates cut off in narrow columns
.xls column widths about twice the .xlsx widths
